name: LeaseLineage
subcategory: commercial real estate prospecting and outreach
tagline: Prospecting, outreach campaigns, tenant demand, and deal tracking for commercial real estate brokers

pricing.notes: Official pricing page lists Pro at $79/month or $69/month billed annually; Brokerage is $249/month.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: Unlimited campaigns and contacts; single-broker plan.
tiers.notes: $828 billed yearly at the annual rate.

tiers.name: Brokerage
tiers.limits: 3 broker seats; unlimited campaigns and contacts.
tiers.notes: $2,388 billed yearly at the annual rate.

pricing.freeTierCaps: no free broker tier; tenant users can participate without a paid broker seat
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual; no setup fee or long-term contract; cancel anytime

verdictSummary: A solo broker can build the CRM, CSV prospecting, draft sequences, and pipeline in a weekend, but reliable contact data, Gmail and Outlook sync, deliverability, compliance operations, and brokerage collaboration are ongoing products.
coreLoopDIY: Import or research prospects, organize them by property or tenant need, draft a reviewed email sequence, and track replies and deal stages.
whatYouLose: Gmail and Outlook OAuth and reply sync
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to keep contact discovery, inbox connections, reply attribution, sending controls, suppression, reporting, and team access working while they focus on brokerage.

priorArt.name: Mautic
priorArt.desc: Open-source marketing automation platform that covers campaigns and contact management, without the commercial real estate workflow.

notes: The personal CRM and drafting loop is buildable; the managed data and email operations are the subscription.
prompt:
Build me a local commercial real estate outreach workspace to replace LeaseLineage. Requirements:

- A local web app using Node, Express, better-sqlite3, and server-rendered EJS,
  with a little vanilla JavaScript; store everything in data/leaselineage.db.
- Import prospects from CSV with company, contact, title, email, market, asset
  class, property, source, and notes; deduplicate by lowercase email.
- Show a prospect table with search, filters, tags, and a detail page containing
  notes, activity history, and a next-follow-up date.
- Let me create a campaign from filtered prospects and draft a three-step email
  sequence with the OpenAI API; keep its key and optional SMTP credentials in .env.
- Every generated message must remain a draft until I approve it. Support test-send,
  scheduled send, daily send limit, unsubscribe footer, and a suppression list.
- Poll one IMAP inbox every five minutes, match replies by Message-ID and email,
  stop remaining steps for that prospect, and show replies in a unified inbox.
- Track opportunities on a kanban board with New, Contacted, Replied, Meeting,
  Proposal, Won, and Lost columns; moving a card writes an activity event.
- Provide CSV exports for prospects, campaigns, activities, and opportunities.
  Bind to localhost only; no accounts or telemetry beyond email and OpenAI calls.
- Out of scope: contact-data enrichment, Gmail or Outlook OAuth, multi-user teams,
  custom sending domains, and legal compliance guarantees.
- Include a README with setup, CSV columns, .env variables, IMAP app-password notes,
  backup instructions, and a warning that I remain responsible for lawful outreach.
